Parameters & Return Values

Order slips IN, served plates OUT. Types must match exactly.

⏱ 15 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Slips in, plates out

Same kitchen, different orders.

🧾

Service counter. Slip says paneer, spice 2 (parameters). Kitchen returns a plate (return value) or shouts “done!” (void). Wrong slip shape? Java REFUSES — compile error, no guessing.

Order slip demo
public class Main {
  static int add(int a, int b) {
    return a + b; // serve the plate, exit now
  }

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    int s = add(4, 5); // argument values 4, 5 fill slots a, b
    System.out.println(s); // 9
    System.out.println(add(10, 20)); // 30, used directly
  }
}
Parameter = slot in definition. Argument = value at call. return serves ONE value and exits instantly.
